(QUIZ APP)


Project Structure :

Code:


package Demo;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class QuizApplication {

	@SuppressWarnings("resource")
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		//Scan
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		
		//Questions
		String[] question= {
				 "Java is?",
				 "Which company developed Java?",
				 "Which keyword is used to create an object?"
		};
		
		//Options
		
		String[][] options = {
			    {"Language", "Database", "OS", "Browser"},
			    {"Google", "Microsoft", "Sun Microsystems", "Apple"},
			    {"new", "create", "object", "class"}
			};
		
		//answers
		int[] answers = {1, 3, 1};
		
		//Score
		
		int score=0;
		
		System.out.println("Quiz");
		int ans;
		int choice = 0;
		while(choice !=2) {
			System.out.println("Enter choice: ");
			System.out.println("1. Play Quiz");
			System.out.println("2. Exit from the quiz");
            choice = sc.nextInt();
			
			switch(choice) {
			case 1 :
			score=0;
			for (int i = 0; i < question.length; i++) {
				
				System.out.println("\nQ" + (i + 1) + ". " + question[i]);
				for (int j = 0; j < options[i].length; j++) {
		            System.out.println((j + 1) + ". " + options[i][j]);
		        }
				
			    
				do {
				    System.out.print("Enter answer (1-4): ");
				    ans = sc.nextInt();

				    if (ans < 1 || ans > 4) {
				        System.out.println("Invalid choice. Try again.");
				    }

				} while (ans < 1 || ans > 4);
			    
			    if (answers[i] == ans) {
			        score++;
			        System.out.println("Correct!");
			    } else {
			        System.out.println("Wrong!");
			    }
			    }
			    
			    double percentage = (score * 100.0) / question.length;

			    System.out.println("\nQuiz Completed!");
			    System.out.println("Score: " + score + "/" + question.length);
			    System.out.println("Percentage: " + percentage + "%");
			
			break;
			
			case 2:	
                 System.out.println("Exiting...");
                 break;

            default:
                 System.out.println("Invalid choice");
			
			}
		}
		
		

	}

}
